release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.24 - Production Update

🎨 Rebrand Portal UI to RJD PISOWIFI
- Updated all portal headers, document titles, and footers to official RJD PISOWIFI branding

⚡ USB-to-LAN & Direct LAN Coinslot Fix
- Fixed coinslot selection for Orange Pi / Raspberry Pi direct LAN connections
- Main Machine (GPIO 12 / Pin 3) is now 100% accessible without needing a VLAN tag

🧹 Log Cleanup & Stability
- Suppressed PGRST205 nodemcu_licenses table schema warnings
- Automatically creates uploads/audio directory to eliminate ENOENT scandir error logs

🚀 1-Click Dashboard GitHub Updater
- Added 1-click 'UPDATE FROM GITHUB' button directly inside the UPDATER admin tab
